title: Raises Bounds
statement: Implement `solve(low, high)`. Return `ok` when `low` is less than or equal to `high`. Return `error` when the bounds are inverted.
hints: Do not clamp a value here. This function only checks the bounds.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The raising case does not belong in the same table as the numeric rows, because the result is not a number.

editorial: The raising case does not belong in the same table as the numeric rows, because the result is not a number. A separate test calls the validator. Inverted bounds are the error. Equal bounds are a legal empty-width range.
